tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'dod khams ma'i bskang gso dngos grub rol mtsho dang rjes 'brel mdos gzhung bcas bzhugs so// swasti/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rab dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i gtor bskang dngos grub rol mtsho zhes zhar la mdos bskang nyung ngu thon pa de nyid nyams su len tshul la/ mdos bskang lhan cig tu bya ba dang / so sor bya ba gnyis/ de la 'dod khams ma rkyang pa dang / dmag zor lha mo'i mdos dang lhan cig tu bya ba gnyis las/ de rnams gang byed kyang bshams ni sa lo'i gsung rab de nyid dang / kho bo'i zur bskol na gsal zhing / nyams len gyi rim par/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma mgon po drug cu pa sogs la byed pa bzhin/ bdag bskyed/ gtor bsngo/ gur mgon gyi bskang gso rdzogs pa'i bar rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du 'gro ba'i/ dngos gzhi mdos bskang lhan cig tu byed na/ de nas lha mo'i mchod gtor a mṛ tas bsangs ba nas nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur bar/ mdos/ sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la mthu dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa'i rjes su/ oṃ sarba bid nas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbar/ bcom dung bcom rol nyis brdeg 'phar yod med gang rung / rdo rje phur pa'i 'phags mchog ma'i 'go bzhin rkang gling g.yab dar bcas/ spyan 'dren nas bshags pa rdzogs pa'i bar rgyun bzhin/ bh+yoḥdrag po'i gzhal yas zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum la de wi ko ḍa'i dbyangs rol tshar gsum/ 'jig rten las kyi nas 'dur shur gang rung / yid bzhin 'grub pa'i tshig rol/ bh+yoḥri rab nas/ srog glu dam pa ri rab mdos chog dang / bar la yang dag don du'i dbyangs kyi mthar gsum brdeg len can/ rin chen nas 'dur shur gang rung / myur du bsad cing la tshig rol/ mdos gzhung tshar gsum tsam gtong na/ yang bh+yoḥdrag po'i gzhal yas nas/ yid bzhin tshig rol bar dbyangs med yug gcig dang / bh+yoḥri rab nas/

myur du bsad cing tshig rol bar dbyangs med par yug gcig grangs gsog rdzogs pa'i myur du bsad cing tshig rol gyi mthar dgu brdeg gnyis rnga phyir brdung gis gzhan gyi rigs sngags nas dam nyams dgra bo'i 'dir tshig rol dgu brdung / ma mo'i nas tshe ring nad med la tshig rol dgu brdung / grangs gsog byed na de bzhin tshar gsum sogs/ grangs gsog rdzogs pa dang dgu brdung rjes ma'i mthar chems brdung gsum brdeg len can/ zhal gyi bskang ba sogs 'phros rnams byas la bstod pa gsar rnying gang byed kyang de'i grangs su nam gru ma'i dbyangs ring gnyis dang / nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod bar dbyangs rol bya tshul dus mdos nyer gsum gyi dbyangs res bzhin no/ /yang mdos bskang rkyang pa byed na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bdag bskyed/ gtor bsngo rnams gong bzhin la/ mdos sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ bcom rol gong bzhin dang / spyan 'dren nas/ rgya chen mchod gtor 'di dag bzhes su gsol bar rgyun bzhin/ 'bul sngags phyi mchod nang mchod 'dod gsol bcas kyang rgyun bzhin mdos gzhung gong bzhin la grangs gsog yod med gang rung gi dgu brdung / rjes ma'i mtha'i chems brdung gsum brdeg len can grub pa dang / lcam dral zhal rnams kyi sngags rnga brdung / bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan srung bsdus pa la lha mor gong bzhin/ rdor glu bkra shis smon lam spyi bstabs/ gzhug chog sogs bya'o/ /yang 'dod khams ma rkyang pa yin na/ cho ga dang dbyangs rol kyi rnam gzhag bshad ma thag pa de nyid gang rung dang / yang 'dod khams ma dang dmag zor ma lhan cig byed par ltar na mdos gzhung gtong tshul le tshan gnyis gang rung gong bzhin la dbyangs rol mi 'dra ba bya dgos te/ kho bos dmag zor ma'i mdos chog 'di/ khrigs su spyan 'dren phyogs phyogs ma la de wī ko ṭi'i dbyangs rol dang /

glud bsngo glu mchog ma la yang dag don du'i dbyangs rol bshad yod pas/ des na 'dod khams ma'i mdos gzhung drag po'i gzhal yas ma la mi pham dbyangs ring dbyangs rol bcas tshar gsum dang / bu dbyangs rol mo bcas tshar gsum dang / glud bsngo ri rab gling bzhi'i sh+lau ka gcig dang / tshig rkang lnga la sring thung rol mo bcas tshar gnyis/ gong du bshad pa'i nam gru ma'i dbyangs rol de rnams dmag zor ma'i phyogs bzhi'i bskul rjes nam gru ma la bcug pas bskang gso'i bstod pa'i gras la 'dod khams ma'i bstod pa gsar rnying gi go chod/ dmag zor ma rkyang pa yin na nam gru ma la ma dbyangs bu dbyangs gnyis las gzhan mi dgos/ dbyangs shin tu mang bar bya dgos pa 'di rnams kyang cho ga yun ring khyad tsam ma yin par/ spyir yi dam chos skyong zhi khro rnams gdul bya'i dbang gi dbyangs rol gar la dgos pa ma zad/ khyad par dpal ldan lha mo ni dbyangs la shin tu mnyes pa zhig te/ sngon gyi dus su srin po rda sha gri bas lha mo dung skyong ma dbyangs kyis thugs drangs nas srin yul du bsus pa dang / de rjes bya rgyud rig pa mchog las phyag na rdo rjes nam gru'i rigs dang cho 'brang la bstod pa gsungs pa dang / lo chen rin chen bzang pos stag mos ngur dbyangs mdzad pas gur mgon zhal gzigs/ rjes bla ma shrār+dhas lha mo la yang de bzhin gyis gsungs skabs yan la lam du lha mos lung bstan nas mi pham ma'i dbyangs gnyis mdzad pa dang / til mar la chu gnyer ma'i dbyangs mdzad cing / rgya gar nas tshur 'byon lam chur brgal ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i lha mo zhi drag gi bstod pa'i dpe klus brkus nas rgya mtsho'i gting gi klu rnams kyi dbyangs rten par thugs mgu bas mi yul du re zhig ma byon pa la/ lo chen gyis pi waṃ gling bu'i gdang ltar dbyangs mdzad pas slar zhal gzigs par gsung pa sogs lo rgyus mang zhing /

de'i nang nas kyang rang re'i lugs la dbyangs rol gcig pos kyang dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub nus pa ni/ go rams bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seṅges gzhan gyi ting 'dzin lo brgya bsgoms pa dang / sngags lo brgya bzlas pa bas kyang dbyangs rol nus pa che bar dgongs te a la la sa skya pa'i dbyangs rol phyag len 'di rnams ngo mtshar chen po red ces gsungs pas kyang rtogs nus so/ /zhes 'dod khams dbang mos bskang gso dngos grub rol mtsho dang rjes 'brel mdos gzhung gtong tshul 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bris// //shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'dod khams ma'i bskang gso dang rjes 'brel mdos gzhung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
